batch.description: HSTU A Unit (Agriculture/Fisheries/Veterinary, Science group) MCQ question bank, academic session 2014-2015 (Satt Academy year label 2014), transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Biology 15 of 25, English 15 of 25; page 2 of each subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched). All 60 publicly readable cards are included. Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against each card's test-mode answer field); content is not cross-source verified. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: HSTU A Unit 2014 MCQ Question Bank & Solution (Satt Academy)
sourceDocuments.notes: HTML question bank at https://sattacademy.com/a-%E0%A6%87%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%9F-103/all/mcq-questions , retrieved 2026-10-31; local copy sources/satt-hstu-a-2014.html (sha256 is of that 'all' page). Per-subject first pages retrieved the same day via the site's own subject endpoints are stored under sources/satt-hstu-a-2014/ (physics/chemistry/biology/english-p1.html). Page 2 of each subject section requires login on Satt Academy (curl and browser.open both returned the login page on 2026-10-31) and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so 40 of the advertised 100 questions are not in this pack. Subject counts advertised on the page: English 25, Physics 25, Chemistry 25, Biology 25 = 100. MathML formulas are transcribed in a linear text form (e.g. R/4 rendered as R4 in the source text layer). Source anomalies preserved verbatim: Chemistry #6 and #7 share the same question text in the source but have different option sets; Physics #3 option d is the source's own placeholder text 'নিজে চেষ্টা করুন' and is the option the source marks correct. No independent second source was provided for this paper (independentSecondUrl empty), so content is unverified. Satt's on-page date field (05-02-2014) is a template artifact and was not used for dating; session 2014-2015 follows the exam calendar year 2014 mapping given in the assignment notes.
